[[File:JKJOhs_imperialworker.png|thumb|An Imperial worker.]]

'''Imperial workers''' were engineers used by the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] that wore hazardous environment suits as the conditions they had to work in were often dangerous. Primarily used in operating machinery and conducting repairs, therefor were not armored, though their toughened suits could absorb mild blast damage, and were armed with a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17]] blaster for personal protection. Many of them were slain by [[Kyle Katarn]] when he encountered them on his adventures.<ref name="JO">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref><ref name="JA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>

[[Jaden Korr]] discovered a group of Imperial workers when he [[Mission to Nar Kreeta|encountered]] them working with a local [[Unidentified Hutt crime lord (Nar Kreeta)|Hutt crimelord]] on [[Nar Kreeta]] and found corpses on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] during [[Mission to Bakura (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|his mission there]], apparently of these workers who had resisted the Disciples.<ref name="JA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial worker is available as a multiplayer character in both the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]'' video games.<ref name="JO" /><ref name="JA" />
